description: This file defines a translation memory system for managing translation entries, including loading from and saving to a JSON-based storage, and methods for accessing and modifying translation entries.

classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: A struct for managing translation entries loaded from JSON files, providing methods to load, save, put, and retrieve translation entries.

classes.name: TMEntry
classes.description: A struct representing individual translation memory entries, including fields for source text, translation, language, provider, model, and timestamps.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads a translation memory from a specified JSONL file, returning a TranslationMemory instance.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translation entry by cache key, return value indicates whether a valid translation is found.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Adds or updates a translation entry in the memory.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the current translation memory entries back to the file in JSONL format.
